notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.notes:
As a solo dev, this project has been a great journey, the one that started it all, games like Locked Up and From The Darkness would be a great inspiration to create this game without forgetting games like Silent Hill to make possible this game, and now with the help of indie.io We will be able to reach even more players so they can join in this incredible journey. 🎉🎉🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686564/e6aee4326182911ec55f25e7adfa48cbb7e78452.png[/img]

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.😁

Thank you so much for your support in this journey:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2095140/Locked_in_my_Darkness/

Check out the other amazing indie games being published by indie.io here!

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio

notes.title: Locked in my Darkness 2: The Room
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

I want to present to you the sequel to what was my first game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3330930/Locked_in_my_Darkness_2_The_Room/

This game  is a first-person psychological horror game that focuses on exploring and creating fear in the player also is a direct sequel of Blue Maiden too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686564/1a14588e7cd412d84b106297dce2868dc9904cd7.png[/img]

[b]Story[/b]

You are Yuki Tachibana, an exchange student who traveled from Tokyo, Japan to New York, USA, to study a new language, but when you arrive at your apartment you notice that something is wrong with it and you decide to investigate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686564/1707de9e4d37033cd5a1b10b4f7458d2d94e78c0.png[/img]

[b]Features[/b]

Immersive experience: An atmospheric-realistic graphics.
Gameplay: This game is primarly a first person psychological horror walking simulator.
Psychological horror: The game contains some disturbing audio for the horror experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686564/a9c30210563456d8eb8f8eef5d6468458e0a8952.png[/img]

Thanks you for your support.

notes.title: Blue Maiden Demo Release On October 9
notes.notes:
Hi guys long time no see you.

First of all I want to thank you for all the support that Blue Maiden has received throughout these months, the development of this second game has been easier compared to my first game, I applied a lot of the feedback I received from the first game to this second game and many things that I couldn't include in Locked in my Darkness I introduced in this second game, I hope you enjoy this demo since it inspires me a lot in Japanese culture, especially in games like Fatal Frame and the Chilla's Art saga. For this second game, I also want to clarify that this game is in the same universe as Locked in my Darkness, I hope you can find it. the references in this demo, without further ado let's get to the content.

[h3]The Demo[/h3]

This demo will contain Chapter 2 and Chapter 4 of the full game. The duration of this demo, depending on the player's skill, could take between 20 to 40 minutes to finish depending on the player's pace.

If you like it please add it to the wishlist On Steam.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949265/78583d41ec36af2ec72182a208400eec81acf032.jpg[/img]

[h3]The Game[/h3]

My goal for Blue Maiden is to be 2 hours long, twice as long as my first game.

I want to thank you to my Beta Testers for testing the demo so early and Shaddy Unicorn for helping me to correct the English translation of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949265/c5436a308315ef626f96ed91d0e931761028542c.jpg[/img]

Thanks for everything and wait for more news soon, stay tuned.

Blusagi Team.

[h2][u]Future plans:[/u][/h2]

It's a pleasure to show you the second game I'm working on. please add it to your wishlist.

[h1]Blue Maiden[/h1] is a Japanese first person psychological horror game that focuses on exploring and finding answers to the mystery of the old neighborhood.

[h3]Story[/h3]
You are Tachi Tachibana, a graduated university student, after graduating you decide to return to your neighborhood to help at the family business, you have been dreaming the same nightmare in which you find a mysterious girl, when You finally arrive in your neighborhood, you notice that something is not right, and you must find out what is happening.

[h3]Features[/h3]
Most of the time you have to walk and explore different traditional Japanese locations to find clues and solve the mystery of the Blue Maiden.

[list]
[*] [b]Immersive Experience:[/b] An Atmospheric Graphics.
[*] [b]Japanese Theme:[/b] Environment inspired by Japanese horror games.
[*] [b]Psychological horror:[/b] The game contains some jumpscares that could be disturbing.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EIw9UZ4.jpeg[/img]

The Demo was scheduled to be released on October 25, 2022, seeing the enthusiasm of our followers, we have decided to launch it earlier, so the new release date will be:
